successors.name: British Bechuanaland
successors.text: Stellaland and Goshen, the 'United States of Stellaland'

ledger.x: 26 July 1882: Boer mercenaries proclaim the Republic of Stellaland on Mankoroane's land.
August 1885: the British abolish the republic after Warren's expedition.
August 1885: the United States of Stellaland ends.

wars.name: Warren Expedition
